- As the century wore on, the world was remade in the image of its makers, a new world order emerging from the ashes of the old.

- And when the dust finally settled, a new world emerged, forged in the fire of conflict and tempered by the trials of the human spirit.

- The 20th century was a testament to the indomitable will of humanity, a shining beacon of hope in a world torn apart by strife and despair.

- As the curtain falls on this epic drama, we are left to ponder the lessons of the past, and to wonder what the future may hold.

- The 20th century was a time of great change, a time of great upheaval, and a time of great transformation.

- And as we look out upon the world of today, we are reminded that the story of humanity is far from over, that the next chapter in the epic saga of our species is yet to be written.

- The 20th century was a time of great triumph, a time of great tragedy, and a time of great transformation.
